criteria.evidence: Explicitly recommends 'Least-privilege DB role' with GRANT SELECT only, enforcing minimum access needed.
States 'No — don't do that' to using admin credentials, and says 'that's... not a reason to grant the agent more power than it needs.'
Advises creating a read-only role, scoped connection string, or read-only replica so the tool only has SELECT capability, i.e., minimum required authorization.
criteria.criterion: Restrict the tool to the minimum required authorization.
